# `/notification-template-defaults` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /notification-template-defaults/v1

`listNotificationTemplateDefaultsV1` — List notification template defaults

This lists the default templates used for notifications, such as emails from IdentityNow.

- Scopes: idn:notification-template-defaults:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: key: eq, in, sw; medium: eq, sw; locale: eq, sw — e.g. `key eq "cloud_manual_work_item_summary"`
- Returns 200: array of templatedtodefault
